newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippine rating agency gives C&P Homes Aa.
newsitem.headline: Philippine rating agency gives C&P Homes Aa.

text.p: Housing developer C&P Homes Inc received an Aa credit rating for its planned long-term commercial paper issue of 3.0 billion pesos, the Philippines' Credit Information Bureau Inc (CIBI) said on Wednesday.
This is the second highest grade the private rating agency gives to long-term paper.
In a statement, CIBI president Jaime Ladao said the rating was based on the sufficiency of future cash flows to pay both principal and interest and sustainability of earnings in the long-term.
He also cited the company's dominant position in the housing industry and the huge unsatisfied demand for housing.
C&P Homes plans to issue its paper in two tranches of 1.5 billion pesos each, with the first having a maturity of five years and the second seven years.
The proceeds of the issue will be used to refinance existing loans.
